_comment: One entry per URL shape in /sitemap.xml. Shared by backend/tests/test_sitemap.py (every generated URL matches a shape), frontend/src/AppRoutes.test.tsx (every sample renders something other than NotFound) and scripts/synthetic/check.mjs (every sample renders in a real browser). A new sitemap shape fails the backend test until it is added here, which makes the other two check it.
